author: raoatifshad
body:
** PR description **
Adds `send_test_log_scans.py`, the sender for the IB test-log scan files written by the scan hook.

**What it does**
- Finds `unitTestLogs-scan.json.gz`, `addOnTests-scan.json.gz` and `pyRelValMatrixLogs-scan.json.gz`
  under `/data/sdt/buildlogs/<arch>/www/<day>/<queue>/<IB tag>/[gpu/<card>/|other/<name>/]`
  (globs only these levels, never walks the RelVal workflow folders).
- POSTs each new or changed file to the IB chatbot (`cmssdt-chatbot.cern.ch`, `/api/test-logs/ingest`)
  and leaves a `<file>.sent` marker (`<sha256> <answer> <time>`) next to it. A file is sent again only
  when its content changed (a RelVal scan is rewritten when a late job is merged).
- Reads only the `*-scan.json.gz` files and writes only the `.sent` markers; never touches the logs,
  zips or anything else of cms-bot. The markers go away with the weekday folder, like the zips.
- Standard library only, Python 3.8+. Never prints the token.

**Jenkins**  job `send-test-log-scans` already exists (disabled) on node `cmssdt`, every 15 min:

    python3 $CMS_BOT_DIR/send_test_log_scans.py --url http://cmssdt-chatbot.cern.ch:8001 --resend-days ${RESEND_DAYS:-0}

Token from the Secret text credential `chatbot-test-logs-token`, bound to `TEST_LOGS_INGEST_TOKEN`
(checked from the job: the VM accepts it). Exit 0 = done, 1 = some files failed/rejected (build
unstable, retried next run), 2 = token refused or ingest off (nothing sent).
title: Send the IB test-log scan files to the IB chatbot
